VELOCITY - 7 days, 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-22: the core market went 193 to 193 requisitions (0).
Prompt and context engineering 12% to 9% (-3).

quaere: Data platform is the segment to aim at first. It is the only one where a non-trivial share of roles can be reached from Pune today, and its demand list is the plan's lowest-hanging fruit: the top ask overlaps exactly with the next two plan rows queued, so finishing them moves the readiness number on the single biggest available lever. Zero readiness against every segment at month one is not a verdict, it is the starting line; the ranking is telling him which gap closes the most reach, not which candidate is closest to hired. Frontier lab, applied, and agent engineer stay on the bench until Python architecture is shipped, because their top asks either sit downstream of that work or require a footprint he does not yet have. Travel-readiness narrative and customer-site posture deserve a quiet parallel track, since a third of data platform roles will reject him on location the moment he is technically eligible. Velocity is flat and prompt engineering demand is already softening, so chasing that signal this week would be motion mistaken for progress.
